timeline.summary: Received an income tax demand order of ₹8.98 Cr from the Income Tax Assessment Authority.
TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited confirmed it is not a Large Corporate as of March 31, 2026, per SEBI Circular dated October 19, 2023.

On 30 April 2026, wholly owned subsidiary TVS SCS Global Freight Solutions filed an appeal before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) against a ₹6.71 Cr tax demand under Section 143(3), and sought a stay of the demand.

Promoter T.S. Rajam Rubbers Private Limited filed a SAST Regulation 31(4) declaration on 3 April 2026 listing four share pledges created between February 2025 and December 2025 and stating no other encumbrance.
Dhinrama Mobility Solution Pvt Ltd’s promoter **R. PIX** and **R. Padmapriya** declared no encumbrance on TVS Supply Chain Solutions shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Reg 31(4).
B.Srinivasan, Promoter Group, declared no encumbrance on TVS Supply Chain Solutions shares for FY2026 under SEBI Regulation 31(4).
On May 21, 2026, TVS Supply Chain Solutions announced a ₹59.56 Cr equity infusion into wholly owned subsidiary FIT 3PL Warehousing Private Limited.
On May 22, 2026, TVS Supply Chain Solutions disclosed filing an appeal before the CIT(Appeals) against an ₹8.99 Cr income tax demand.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,032.22 Cr (+21.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹17.55 Cr (against a loss of ₹4.76 Cr a year earlier).

TVS Supply Chain Solutions reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,032.22 Cr (+21.4% YoY) and full-year revenue crossing ₹11,000 Cr, alongside a leadership transition with Vikas Chadha appointed as MD.
TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited uploaded Q4 FY26 earnings call recording on May 26, 2026, available at https://www.tvsscs.com/investor-relations/investor-resources/.
On May 26, 2026, TVS Supply Chain Solutions reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,032.2 Cr (+21.3% YoY) and full-year revenue of ₹11,003 Cr.
On June 4, 2026, TVS Supply Chain Solutions approved a JV with A.L.A Corporation, investing ₹10.19 Cr for a 51% stake in TVS Packaging Solutions.
R Haresh, Promoter Group of TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares held during FY2026 ending March 31, 2026.
R Dinesh, Promoter of TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited, declared no encumbrance on his shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
